builds.name: Reference: AD spell pressure
builds.goal: Reference for Riven: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee combo fighter who interleaves charged attacks with dashes and control. AD improves spell damage, passive attacks and her shield, so coherent sequencing is valuable. Measure real attack weaving, Q casts and AD-backed shields. Crit only applies where permitted; poor animation/cancel timing can erase a theoretical attack advantage. AD, haste and Black Cleaver may reward repeated physical ability hits.
builds.summary: AD, haste and Black Cleaver may reward repeated physical ability hits.
testPlan: Kit question for Riven: Measure real attack weaving, Q casts and AD-backed shields. Crit only applies where permitted; poor animation/cancel timing can erase a theoretical attack advantage.

Start with the early core (Eclipse, then Shojin) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: None. Do not treat mana regeneration as None recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AD, haste and Black Cleaver may reward repeated physical ability hits. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Cleaver needs physical damage and ramp; no assumed benefit to true damage.

The route fails Riven's stated kit question: Measure real attack weaving, Q casts and AD-backed shields. Crit only applies where permitted; poor animation/cancel timing can erase a theoretical attack advantage.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Cleaver needs physical damage and ramp; no assumed benefit to true damage.
Full cost 16,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Eclipse, then Shojin. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Black Cleaver, Death's Dance, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: None. Do not treat mana regeneration as None recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

kitEvidence.formula:
Riven dashes forward, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. She can Recast this Ability twice. The first Recast is the same as the original, but the second has a different effect:

Recast: Riven leaps forward and slams, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Knocks Up nearby enemies for 0.75 seconds.
Riven's sword emits a burst of runic energy, dealing [65 / 95 / 125 / 155 / 185 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Stunning for [0.75] seconds.
Riven quickly dashes and gains [70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (1.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for 1.5 seconds.
Using an Ability grants Riven a charge for 6 seconds (max [3]). Her Attacks spend a charge to deal an additional [(characterLevelInterpolation(0.3 → 0.45; raw flags preserved)) × AD] physical damage.

Riven's weapon surges with spiritual energy, granting her [(0.2) × AD] Attack Damage and increased range on damaging Abilities and Attacks for [15] seconds. While active, she can Recast.

Recast: Riven fires a wind slash that deals between [100 / 150 / 200 + (0.55) × AD[statFormula=2]] and [300 / 450 / 600 + (1.65) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, based on their missing Health.
